# netmap-bind

Insert the Netmap kernel module and network drivers for packet I/O.

Unloads any DPDK UIO drivers (igb_uio, uio_pci_generic) first, then
loads the Netmap kernel module and the Netmap-patched i40e and ixgbe
network drivers.

Requires the netmap dependency to be built. Runs as an init script.

Usage:
```bash
%import@dut netmap-bind
```

Source: [`modules/netmap-bind.npf`](https://github.com/tbarbette/npf/blob/main/modules/netmap-bind.npf)

## Variables

This module defines no variables.
